**Resolved / Related Issues**
- Closes #5423

**Details of Changes**
- Added thumbnail fallback for fixing #5423 . Some folders doesn't have an icon on ListView but they have on SingleItem, so with this change more folders will have thumbnail icons when pinned. I added as a fallback because some folders have a bad thumbnail on SingleItem style (they have a black background).

- [ ] Tested the changes for accessibility

issue_context.title: Root folder without icon doesn't have an icon on sidebar (favorites)
issue_context.body:
<!-- 
🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨
I ACKNOWLEDGE THE FOLLOWING BEFORE PROCEEDING:
1. Issue may be deleted if it is not following the template
2. Only post one issue per one bug report
3. Try not to make duplicates. Do a quick search before posting
4. Add a title that describes the issue clearly
--->

**Explain the bug**
EDITION: It seems that they indeed have icons, but Files can't get it. This also happens with MTP root folders. So the bug is some root folders (smb, MTP) can't get their icon in Files.

**To reproduce**
1. Go to the root folder of a SMB / MTP folder. I'm using the root folder of a Synology NAS with SMB.
2. Right click and pin to favorites.
3. Root folder pinned to sidebar will not have an icon, but if you repeat those steps with subfolders, those will have it (check screenshot for better explanation).

**Expected behavior**
Should have an icon. Maybe a standard icon for any folder that doesn't have an icon?

**Logfile**
[debug.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/6812040/debug.log)
[debug_fulltrust.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/6812041/debug_fulltrust.log)


**Screenshots**
Windows explorer:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11770760/126789493-1d3c4e44-6840-468c-b50c-ec2199b486ed.png)

Files:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11770760/126789542-ce034820-e76f-4e93-b407-2e53f53cb639.png)



**System Information**
- OS Version: Windows 10 Pro 21H1 19043.1081 Windows Feature Experience Pack 120.2212.3530.0
- App version: 1.5.62.0

**Additional comment**
This problem still happen after restarting the app.
comments: This issue will happen when the `hidden` attribute is set. Try to uncheck the `hidden` attribute from Properties > Hidden,  this method works for me.

> This issue will happen when the `hidden` attribute is set. Try to uncheck the `hidden` attribute from Properties > Hidden, this method works for me.

Hello, thanks for the answer, but there is no properties for smb folders, or at least for this folder.

In Windows explorer there is no option of "Properties", and on Files there is, but if I click on it nothing happens.
